data.desc: Yum! Brands is a leading restaurant company that grows iconic brands globally, powered by world-class talent, franchise partners and technology. More than 44,000 restaurants across 150-plus countries and territories are operated by Yum! subsidiaries or franchisees under the iconic brands of KFC, Taco Bell and Habit Burger & Grill. KFC and Taco Bell are global leaders in their respective categories, while Habit Burger & Grill is a fast-casual concept known for made-to-order chargrilled burgers, sandwiches and more. Guided by its Recipe for Good Growth and Raising the B.A.R. priorities, Yum! brings together its global brands, franchise system, scale and leading digital and technology capabilities to drive growth and create long-term value. Together, these strengths help Yum! build the world's most loved, trusted and connected restaurant brands.
